source_reaction.limits: No measured reaction extent,x value,reductant turnover or iodine yield is inferred. Printed comparison of potentials is an explanatory reference,not sample electrochemistry.

source_interpretation.text: The authors propose that ethylenediamine coordinates copper, disperses the reagent and mediates heat and growth. They observe CuI dissolving slowly and the liquid changing from transparent through light to dark blue. This interpretation is not an isolated-complex structure or measured kinetic mechanism.

The displayed reaction uses CuI and selenium to produce Cu2−xSe and iodine. The authors attribute selenium reduction to iodide and argue that precipitation drives the reaction; iodine is said to be removed in washing. This is their mechanistic account, not a separately measured iodine yield.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Displayed reaction and final mechanism paragraph

source_interpretation.text: The main optimum is90 °C for4 h. Lower temperature or shorter time gives incomplete reaction, lower yield/crystallinity and residual Se/CuI by XRD; exact tested points are not supplied. Below50 °C the reaction does not start. Higher temperature or longer time enlarges grains; only180 °C for4 h is numerically linked to a100 nm XRD estimate.
